content.text: Imagine [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-what-nobody-tells-you|COREMERCH guide to selling]] digital products only to be locked out by Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, unable to collect payments from the people who need your products most – like in Zimbabwe, where even the national currency has collapsed. This is not just a problem of payment processing, but of infrastructure [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-actually-how|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-4|sovereign]]ty. Without a reliable way to process crypto payments, digital creators are forced to rely on restrictive platforms that take a cut of their earnings and hold their customers hostage. But what if you could build your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, free from the limitations of Stripe and others? Welcome to the world of Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation, where you can process orders, deliver products, and collect payments without ever relying on a third-party payment processor.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting platform that allows you to build custom business applications that integrate with Google Sheets, Google Drive, and other Google services. In the context of digital commerce automation, it serves as the brain of your sovereign stack, processing orders, sending notifications, and triggering automated workflows. This is not just a tool, but a game-changer for digital creators who want to take control of their business and break free from the shackles of restrictive payment processors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A correctly configured sovereign stack processes orders in under 30 seconds, thanks to the power of Google Apps Script and Cloudflare Workers. When a customer makes a payment on your site, the NOWPayments webhook fires, triggering a Cloudflare Worker to process the order and update the Supabase database. The Google Apps Script then kicks in, sending a notification to the customer and triggering the automated delivery of the digital product. It's a seamless process that happens in real-time, without any human intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators who want to sell digital products, but can't rely on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad due to platform restrictions. Whether you're in Zimbabwe, Ghana, Kenya, or anywhere else in the world where traditional payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted, Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation is the solution you need. It's not just a workaround, but a sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control of your business and your customers.
With Google Apps Script, you can process orders, deliver products, and collect payments in under 30 seconds.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured sovereign stack that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. With this stack, you get a fully functional e-commerce platform that can process orders, deliver products, and collect payments in under 30 seconds. The Cloudflare Workers handle the webhook events, while the Supabase database stores the order information. The Google Apps Script then kicks in, sending notifications and triggering automated workflows. It's a powerful combination that makes digital commerce automation a breeze.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure using Google Apps Script, follow these steps: Create a new Google Apps Script project and connect it to your Supabase database. Set up the NOWPayments webhook to trigger the Cloudflare Worker, which will process the order and update the database. Write the Google Apps Script code to send notifications and trigger automated workflows. Finally, deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) on Cloudflare Pages and configure the SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings. With these steps, you can have your own sovereign commerce infrastructure up and running in no time.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

The most important question on everyone's mind is: 'How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?' The answer is simple: when a customer makes a payment on your site, the NOWPayments webhook fires, triggering a Cloudflare Worker to process the order and update the Supabase database. The Google Apps Script then kicks in, sending a notification to the customer and triggering the automated delivery of the digital product. It's a seamless process that happens in real-time, without any human intervention.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure using Google Apps Script, follow these steps: Create a new Google Apps Script project and connect it to your Supabase database. Set up the NOWPayments webhook to trigger the Cloudflare Worker, which will process the order and update the database. Write the Google Apps Script code to send notifications and trigger automated workflows. Deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) on Cloudflare Pages and configure the SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings. Finally, test your infrastructure to ensure everything is working as expected.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does Cloudflare Workers handle webhook events?

Cloudflare Workers can handle up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, making it an ideal solution for high-traffic e-commerce sites. With Cloudflare Workers, you can process orders, update databases, and trigger automated workflows in real-time, without any human intervention.
What is the role of Supabase in the sovereign stack?

Supabase serves as the database for your sovereign stack, storing order information and other critical data. With Supabase, you can easily manage your orders, customers, and products, and trigger automated workflows based on specific conditions.
Can I use Google Apps Script with other e-commerce platforms?

Yes, you can use Google Apps Script with other e-commerce platforms, including Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento. However, for a seamless experience, we recommend using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments.
How do I configure the SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings?

To configure the SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings, follow these steps: Set up a TXT record for your domain with the SPF value. Create a new TXT record for your domain with the DKIM value. Set up a TXT record for your domain with the DMARC value. With these settings, you can ensure that your emails are delivered to customers' inboxes and not marked as spam.
Can I use NOWPayments with other payment gateways?

Yes, you can use NOWPayments with other payment gateways, including Stripe, PayPal, and Square. However, for a seamless experience, we recommend using NOWPayments, which offers low fees, fast processing times, and automatic webhook triggers.
How do I test my infrastructure to ensure everything is working as expected?

To test your infrastructure, follow these steps: Create a new order on your site and verify that the order is processed correctly. Test the automated delivery of the digital product to ensure that it is delivered correctly. Check the Supabase database to ensure that the order information is updated correctly. With these steps, you can ensure that your infrastructure is working as expected and that your customers receive their orders and products correctly.
